_note: Values read from the papers' text/tables (figures-only results are given as qualitative claims). Sources: arXiv 2605.28533 (Tenzer), 2506.16416 (Timans), 2402.03683 (Ryu-Wornell), 2406.10490 (Xu), 2602.02229 (Zhang/PPRM).

xu.claim: pretrain and learned reach lower beta-hat than all and oblivious at equal labels

timans.claim: wealth process has lowest detection delay among trackers with false-alarm guarantees; running risk shows false positives for small windows; psi-CS shrinks as degradation worsens

tenzer.claim: combined e-process including the imputed statistic has higher power than without, at all correlation levels; one-sided PPI beats two-sided PPI; settings: n_training=15, n_test in {30,135}, M=128, 500 steps, 500 reps

ryu_wornell.claim: KT(K) tighter than per-coordinate baselines early, baselines win in the long run (Fig 1: K in {3,4,5}, T=100, 100 runs); UP(K) much tighter than KT(K) when concentrated (Fig 3)
